question: What will the first reported revenues after September 2026 be for the following companies? (Nvidia)

calls.reasoning: Nvidia guided Q3 FY27 to $108.0B ±2%. Over the last 8 quarters reported revenue beat the guidance midpoint by roughly 2.5-8% (median ~5%; Q2 FY27: $96.2B vs $91B guide), implying a central estimate of ~$113B. Sell-side consensus is ~$109B (range $104.9-116.3B) and likely lags the habitual beat. Taiwan ODM record September revenue on GB300 shipments supports a normal-to-strong beat. Downside risks (AI financing pullback, export controls) mostly affect later quarters given the late-October quarter close. P(>$116B) ≈10% (needs a >7.4% beat, seen in 1 of 8 quarters). The Manifold market (4 holders, contract matches) is roughly consistent but too thin to anchor on.

- Status quo: a reported number between the top of guidance and a +8% beat.
- Resolves off GAAP total revenue in Nvidia's Q3 FY27 earnings release/8-K, not data center revenue and not later revisions.

calls.reconciliation: There were no material factual disputes. All three runs cite the same $108B ±2% guide, the same 8-quarter beat history (+2.5% to +8%), the same Foxconn September data and the same financing headwinds. The earnings date differs (Nov 18 vs Nov 25), but both fall inside the window, so it doesn't affect resolution. One run cited a sell-side consensus of ~$109B; it trails the habitual beat and doesn't change the picture. The remaining judgment calls were tail width and escape mass. I kept the runs' dispersion and set the escape at 10%, matching the observed frequency of beats above 7.4%. I nudged the conditional percentiles slightly lower, because the in-range distribution excludes the upper escape mass.
